title: POTV Lobo Dosing Capsule Caddy Insert for Tightvac – 0.12L
description:
Convert your 0.12L Tightvac into a POTV Lobo Capsule Caddy!

Slide this insert into your 0.12L tightvac storage container and convert it into a convenient organizer for up to 30 POTV Lobo dosing capsules!

It’s the perfect accessory to prepack and store dosing capsules for back to back sessions with your POTV Lobo, at home or with a group of friends.

Extra storage for accessories or herbs

Along with the slots for your dosing capsules, this caddy insert also comes with extra storage space for accessories like stir tools and brushes, or some extra herbs!

Organize your dry herbs

Use the numbered columns to organize your dry herbs. Organize each one by fresh and used, or use them to separate completely different herbs and blends. It’s up to you!

Available in Black, Blue & Green

Bundle with a set of dosing capsules

Save on a set of POTV Lobo Dosing Capsules when you bundle them with our Caddy! Available in sets of 4, 8, 12,16, 24 and 28!

Tightvac storage container NOT included

This product is only the capsule caddy insert and does not include a Tightvac container or the dosing capsules.

Return policy

We only accept returns for accessories if they are within 30 days, unused and unopened, or if they are being returned with a vaporizer under our 14-day satisfaction policy.

See more of our POTV Lobo parts and accessories.
